🔥🇲🇽 COURT: MORENA CAN PUT SALINAS PLIEGO'S FACE ON BLAST

Mexico's top electoral court ruled Morena can keep using billionaire Ricardo Salinas Pliego's image in its messaging. The TV Azteca magnate — the opposition's deepest pocket — tried to kill a spot slamming those who "have enriched themselves thanks to public resources." The TEPJF said no: as a constant player in public affairs he's fair game, and the message is "a value judgment or political opinion without direct imputation" of falsehood. The richest man fighting the 4T just lost the right to hide.

🇲🇽🛢️ PEMEX AND PETROBRAS JOIN FORCES IN THE GULF

Pemex and Brazil's Petrobras signed a cooperation memorandum on June 23 — joint work on deepwater exploration in the Gulf, mature-field recovery, refining, fertilizers and gas processing. Two state oil companies pooling expertise instead of handing the basin to foreign majors. Petrobras chief Magda Chambriard said the deal positions Brazil "as Pemex's partner in strengthening petroleum exploration and production in Mexico." South-South energy integration, in writing.

🇲🇽🏭 190 BILLION PESOS TO REBUILD VERACRUZ'S PETROCHEMICAL CORRIDOR

Sheinbaum committed 190 billion pesos to Veracruz — 93 billion of it to revive the petrochemical complex neoliberalism left to rot: Etileno, Aromáticos, Amoniaco, Fertinal and Escolín, plus highways, water systems and IMSS-Bienestar hospitals. Announced from the naval shipyards in Coatzacoalcos alongside Gov. Rocío Nahle, who called it a chance "to accelerate economic growth" in the south. Reindustrializing the Gulf instead of selling it off.

🇲🇽🌽 MEXICO GUARANTEES A PRICE FLOOR FOR ITS BEAN FARMERS

Mexico guarantees a floor price for its bean growers — something neoliberal governments never bothered to do. After pressure from Durango producers, Sader agreed to absorb more of the harvest, expanding state purchases from 80,000 to 96,000 tons at guaranteed prices. Farmers want the rate lifted from 16,000 to 27,000 pesos a ton on a crop topping 400,000 tons. The argument isn't whether the state buys — it's how much. That floor is the 4T baseline.

🇲🇽🌎 T-MEC SURVIVES — NO ONE CAN WALK AWAY FOR A DECADE

No country can exit the T-MEC for at least 10 more years. With nobody triggering Article 34.7's withdrawal clause in time, Economy Secretary Marcelo Ebrard confirmed the treaty stays alive — and ~85% of Mexico–US trade still moves tariff-free, despite Trump's opening threat of a blanket 25%. On July 1 Sheinbaum signs Mexico's letter pushing for the full 16-year extension. "The worst-case scenario is that it continues for 10 years," Ebrard said.

🚨🇲🇽 TRUMP'S TARIFFS HAVE GUTTED 111,000 MEXICAN FACTORY JOBS

INEGI data shows Mexico lost 111,347 industrial jobs in the year to February — part of over 213,000 destroyed across Mexico and the US by Trump's tariffs. Transportation equipment was hit hardest (-47,436), followed by plastics, rubber and clothing. Mexican factory employment has now fallen for 33 straight months — the same tariffs Washington promised would bring jobs home.

🚨🇲🇽 CUSTOMS SEIZES 500 KILOS OF TEPEZCOHUITE BOUND FOR THE UK

The National Customs Agency and the Navy intercepted 500 kg of tepezcohuite — Mexico's «skin tree» bark — in 19 sealed boxes at Mexico City's airport, headed for the United Kingdom. It's the second bust in 10 days after 1,700 kg destined for the Netherlands; authorities are probing networks moving the plant for clandestine chemical processing.

🇲🇽🏥 UNDOING WHAT NEOLIBERALISM DID TO MEXICO'S HEALTH SYSTEM

Sheinbaum laid out the numbers: 42 new-generation CT scanners in IMSS hospitals, telemedicine expanded from 239 to 859 ISSSTE units, 42,000 upgrades across 8,483 IMSS-Bienestar facilities, 4.6 billion pesos spent in 2025, and over 20 million home visits through Salud Casa por Casa. «We are repairing the deep damage neoliberalism caused to the system,» she said.

🇲🇽🚆 MEXICO CITY PUTS WORLD CUP MONEY INTO THE METRO, NOT A PARTY

Brugada's government rebuilt four Line 2 stations — Tasqueña, General Anaya, Ermita and Portales — for 2.2 billion pesos, with 1.5 billion of the World Cup host-city funds going into permanent track, electrical and fire-safety work. Over 100,000 daily riders benefit; Chabacano reopened June 23. «This is not superficial or cosmetic work,» Brugada said.

🇲🇽🌎 MEXICO TELLS ITS AMBASSADORS: GO TELL THE WORLD WHAT THE 4T BUILT

Foreign Secretary Roberto Velasco convened the heads of every Mexican diplomatic mission and ordered them to broadcast the government's record on welfare, security and the economy abroad. With the foreign right-wing press running disinformation campaigns against Sheinbaum, the SRE is done letting others write Mexico's story.
